title: Sterivex DNA Extraction Protocol
author: Ariel Rabines
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bc2hiyb6

steps.title: Prepare DNA Lysis Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare the DNA lysis buffer for the total number of samples (N) plus extra for pipetting.

substeps.instruction: Add 800 µL x N of Lysis Buffer MC1 to a sterile container.
Add 10 µL x N RNase A.
Optionally, add 1 µL x N of each internal standard.
Mix well.

steps.title: Load Sterivex Filters
steps.instruction: Add the prepared lysis buffer to the Sterivex filters while keeping them on dry ice.

substeps.instruction: Remove the luer plug from each Sterivex filter.
Pipette the per-sample volume (e.g., 812 µL if 800 µL MC1, 10 µL RNase A, and 2 µL internal standards were used) into each filter quickly to prevent freezing upon contact.
Replug with luer lock.
Place filters luer-side down into a 1.5 mL tube rack.

steps.title: Incubate and Lyse
steps.instruction: Incubate the samples to facilitate lysis.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at 56 °C and shake gently for 30 minutes.
Vortex for 5 minutes using an adapter for 5 mL tubes.

steps.title: Extract Lysate from Sterivex
steps.instruction: Recover the lysate from the Sterivex filters into labeled 1.5 mL tubes.

substeps.instruction: Transfer lysate to sterile 1.5 mL tubes labeled with extraction numbers.
Label each Sterivex filter with its extraction number.
Use tube cutters to pop the lid off the male end of the Sterivex by applying pressure at an upward angle in the lip between the lid and the unit; cut around the top if needed.
Rub the filter on the inside of the Sterivex to release remaining lysis buffer and material.
Pipette as much remaining liquid as possible from inside the Sterivex into the corresponding 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Clear Lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysate to clear it and prepare buffers.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge lysate at 5600 x g for 20 minutes.
Prepare buffers using the epMotion program, adding a few mL more than requested.
Premix beads and Binding Buffer MC2 at a ratio of 30 µL beads : 770 µL MC2.

steps.title: Prepare Samples for epMotion
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a deep well plate.

substeps.instruction: Transfer lysate to another set of numbered 1.5 mL tubes.
Remove as much supernatant as possible without disturbing the pellet.
Align 1.5 mL tubes in a rack in plate position.
Using an adjustable spacer multichannel pipette set to 800 µL, transfer no more than 800 µL into a deep well plate.

steps.title: Run epMotion Extraction
steps.instruction: Process the samples using the epMotion automated system.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the deep well plate to the epMotion and run the program.
Set up the reservoir rack layout from left to right: MC2 with beads, MC3, MC4, 80% EtOH, MC5, and MC6.
When the program stops at Step 2, use a P1000 multichannel pipette to thoroughly pipette up and down to mix the bead solution, then resume the run.
Perform final elution into a twin.tec LoBind PCR plate.

steps.title: Quality Control and Dilution
steps.instruction: Verify DNA extraction quality and prepare dilutions for PCR.

substeps.instruction: Run 2.5 µL of the extracted DNA on a gel (bright high molecular weight band indicates good samples; nothing indicates blanks; smear indicates degradation).
Prepare a 1:10 dilution plate (20 µL total volume) using elution buffer MC6 (5 mM Tris/HCl, pH 8.5) for use as PCR templates.
